answer_text: Based on the two letters, Ms Meera Kapoor is the stronger guest speaker for a school debate. Both applicants are skilled, but her international awards and habit of linking arguments to global and social issues match what senior students care about. She treats debating as a way to grow in confidence and public speaking, which suits teenagers still finding a voice. Mr Sharma has ten years of coaching and a record at national contests, yet his letter stresses technique more than lived examples. For a mixed high-school audience, Kapoor's relatability and wider exposure are more likely to hold attention and show why debate matters beyond the classroom.
